# libtpms / fuzz

libtpms's own fuzz target `fuzz` ([source](source/fuzz.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libtpms (stefanberger/libtpms at 529da950).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, an API contract: TPMLIB_Process must return TPM_SUCCESS (transport-level) for any fuzz command after Startup; TPM-level errors travel in the response buffer, so this fails only on internal failures (e.g. response-buffer realloc failure).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libtpms at commit 529da950.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- TPMLIB_Process must return TPM_SUCCESS (transport-level) for any fuzz command after Startup; TPM-level errors travel in the response buffer, so this fails only on internal failures (e.g. response-buffer realloc failure) ([lines 115-117](source/fuzz.cc#L115-L117)): assert(); not confirmed in the binary.
